questions.q: How was Elijah taken up into heaven?
questions.a: By a whirlwind, with a chariot of fire

questions.q: What did Elisha ask of Elijah before he was taken?
questions.a: A double portion of his spirit

questions.q: With what did Elisha heal the waters of Jericho?
What happened to the widow's pot of oil?
questions.a: It filled every vessel she borrowed

questions.q: What did Elisha do for the Shunammite's son?
How many times did Naaman dip himself in the Jordan?
Who ran after Naaman for gifts and was struck with his leprosy?
What did Elisha's servant see when his eyes were opened at Dothan?
Elisha to his servant — complete it.
questions.text: Fear not: for they that be with [us] are more than they that be with [them].

questions.q: Who was anointed to cut off the house of Ahab?
How did Jezebel die?
questions.a: She was thrown down from a window

questions.q: Which empire carried the northern kingdom of Israel away captive?
Why does 2 Kings say Israel was carried away?
questions.a: They had sinned against the LORD and served idols

questions.q: Which king of Judah spread Sennacherib's letter before the LORD and prayed?
What happened to the Assyrian camp outside Jerusalem?
questions.a: The angel of the LORD smote 185,000

questions.q: What sign did Hezekiah receive that he would be healed?
questions.a: The shadow went back ten degrees

questions.q: Which king seduced Judah to do more evil than the nations?
What did Hilkiah find in the house of the LORD in Josiah's day?
Which king of Babylon besieged and finally burned Jerusalem?
Put these in the order 2 Kings tells them.
